consequence.statement: Policies can now specify fallback values for apiCall context entries using the default field when an API server error occurs; existing policies without this field continue to work unchanged.

assertion.statement: The apiCall.default field was added to context specifications in ClusterPolicy, Policy, CleanupPolicy, and ClusterCleanupPolicy resources, allowing operators to specify a fallback value when an API server returns an error during apiCall execution.
